---
title: "Short Snippet"
---

The morning sun filtered through the tall pines casting long shadows across the damp earth and the stone steps leading down to the quiet harbor below. Jonathan paused at the landing listening to the faint creak of wooden rigging in the distance where the gulls wheeled in wide arcs above the gray water. He carried his pack with steady hands noting the cool draft that drifted off the bay carrying the briny scent of low tide and rotting kelp along the rocks. Every movement felt deliberate honed by weeks of vigilance and unbroken silence. The morning sun filtered through the tall pines casting long shadows across the damp earth and the stone steps leading down to the quiet harbor below. Jonathan paused at the landing listening to the faint creak of wooden rigging in the distance where the gulls wheeled. He marveled at the velvet tapestry hanging beside the desk.
